<section>Chapter 29. "B" Extension for Bit Manipulation, Version 1.0.0 > 29.5. Instructions (in alphabetical order) > 29.5.11. clmul > Description</section>
<previous>#### **Encoding**

|31|25|24|20|19|15|14|12 11||7|6|0|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|0 0 0 0 1 0|1||rs2|rs1||0|0 1|rd||0 1 1 0|0 1 1|
|MINMAX/CLMUL|||||||CLMUL|||OP||</previous>
<target>#### **Description**

clmul produces the lower half of the 2·XLEN carry-less product.</target>
<next>#### **Operation**

```
let rs1_val = X(rs1);
let rs2_val = X(rs2);
let output : xlenbits = 0;
foreach (i from 0 to (xlen - 1) by 1) {
   output = if   ((rs2_val >> i) & 1)
            then output ^ (rs1_val << i);
            else output;
}
X[rd] = output
```</next>
